title: Vendor Analytics Summary Cards — Backend Data Requirements
description: Powers the six KPI cards at the top of Analytics & Reports. Charts and tables are out of scope for this endpoint. The UI always sends an inclusive start_date and end_date. Do not use a range query param.

endpoint.auth: Vendor Bearer token + Application-Token (same as other /api/vendor/* routes)

query.start_date: YYYY-MM-DD. Required. Inclusive start of the reporting window.
query.end_date: YYYY-MM-DD. Required. Inclusive end of the reporting window. Must be on or after start_date.

fields.previous_period: Immediately preceding window of the same length. Used only to compute the ±% badge. Example: 2026-07-26 to 2026-08-24 (30 days) → previous is 2026-06-26 to 2026-07-25.
fields.summary.revenue: Gross completed-order sales in the period. Number, not a formatted string.
fields.summary.orders: Count of completed orders in the period.
fields.summary.customers: Unique buyers who placed a completed order in the period.
fields.summary.conversion_rate: Percent, not a fraction. Example 3.8 means 3.8% (orders / store visitors × 100).
fields.summary.return_rate: Percent of completed orders that were returned. Example 2.4 means 2.4%. Lower is better.
fields.previous_summary: Same six metrics for previous_period so the UI can show the trend badge.
